# Decon Drill

> A hands-on drill: put a typical Level B decontamination line in the right order, see why the order matters, and train with decon and HAZWOPER courses.

Decon Drill (https://decon-drill.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs Decontamination, 40-Hour HAZWOPER, PPE Levels A–D, 40 Hr Fire / Hazmat training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://decon-drill.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [HAZWOPER Micro-Module: Decontamination Procedures](https://decon-drill.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazwoper-micro-module-decontamination-procedures): $14.99 per seat, 20 Min, 29 CFR 1910.120(e) / 1926.65(e). Decon stations and doffing in 20 minutes. Enroll: https://decon-drill.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazwoper-micro-module-decontamination-procedures?buy=584
- [OSHA 40 Hour HAZWOPER Training](https://decon-drill.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training): $249.99 per seat, 40 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e) / 1926.65(e). Decon and site control in depth. Enroll: https://decon-drill.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training?buy=587
- [HAZWOPER Micro-Module: PPE Levels A, B, C & D Explained](https://decon-drill.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazwoper-micro-module-ppe-levels-a-b-c-and-d-explained): $12.99 per seat, 15 Min, 29 CFR 1910.120(e) / 1926.65(e). What you're taking off, level by level. Enroll: https://decon-drill.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazwoper-micro-module-ppe-levels-a-b-c-and-d-explained?buy=585
- [OSHA 40 Hour HAZWOPER for Emergency Response/Fire-Hazmat Teams](https://decon-drill.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-for-emergency-response-fire-hazmat-teams): $249.99 per seat, 40 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e) / 1926.65(e). Technical and mass decon for response teams. Enroll: https://decon-drill.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-for-emergency-response-fire-hazmat-teams?buy=589

## Guides

- [Why the decon order matters](https://decon-drill.hazwoperosha.us/guides/why-decon-order-matters): Every station in the line is placed to keep contamination moving away from the clean side.
- [Running a decon team](https://decon-drill.hazwoperosha.us/guides/running-a-decon-team): The people who run decon need their own plan, PPE and rotation.
